about: Limits that decide whether a screenshot holds a rendered picture, and whether two renders agree. Working values chosen for mstack. None was read from a primary source; re-source or tune them on real captures before treating a result as final.

min_spread.unit: levels out of 255 (largest per-channel standard deviation)
min_spread.source: mstack working value, no primary source
min_spread.note: working value; no primary source states a fixed number

max_dominant_share.unit: share of sampled pixels with the most common colour
max_dominant_share.source: mstack working value, no primary source
max_dominant_share.note: working value; no primary source states a fixed number

max_transparent_share.source: mstack working value, no primary source
max_transparent_share.note: working value; no primary source states a fixed number

max_mean_difference.unit: levels out of 255 (mean absolute channel difference between two renders)
max_mean_difference.source: mstack working value, no primary source
max_mean_difference.note: working value; no primary source states a fixed number

max_changed_share.unit: share of sampled pixels that differ by more than 16 levels
max_changed_share.source: mstack working value, no primary source
max_changed_share.note: working value; no primary source states a fixed number
